manual.industrial_byproducts.line2: {0}§lSulfur Dust§r is a powder found commonly in {1}Mineral Deposits{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line3: It can be found occasionally by {0}crushing{1} §2Lapis Lazuli Ore§r or §2Coal Ore§r, and more commonly in §2Nether Quartz Ore§r and §2Blaze Rods§r.{2}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line4: It is most useful when combined into gunpowder or {0}Industrial Fertilizer{1}.{2}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line5: {0}§lNitrate Dust§r (also known as saltpeter) is mixture of alkali salts found by processing §2Sandstone§r in a {1}Crusher{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line6: In a similar vein to sulfur, nitrate dust can be used in {0}Industrial Fertilizer{1}. It can also be used to catalyze the production of {2}Biodiesel{3}.{4}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line7: {0}§lSlag§r is a mixture of metallic oxides and sulfides common from {1}steel production{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line8: Slag can be made into building blocks, including {0}concrete{1}, and can be used to create {2}Industrial Fertilizer{3}.{4}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line10: Sulfur, slag, and nitrate by themselves are a small boost to growing crops in the {0}Garden Cloche{1}, but are not enough to be used on crops directly.{2}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line11: §2Industrial Fertilizer§r will provide a major boost to the cloche, and is made from all three nutrients above plus water to mix them effectively.
manual.industrial_byproducts.line13: Mixing Nitrate, Sulfur and Charcoal allows for the creation of gunpowder, a far more industrial and consistent process than looting it from monsters.{0}
manual.industrial_byproducts.line14: Gunpowder can be used to make {0}ammunition{1} and {2}explosives{3} quickly and cheaply.
